info.title: Transaction Ledger API
info.description:
Accounts, credit/debit transactions, balances, paginated history and atomic transfers.

Money is a JSON string with two decimals. Every error uses one envelope: `{ "error": { status, code, message, details?, context?, request_id, timestamp, path } }`.

Transactions and transfers are immutable: any verb other than the documented one returns 405 `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` with an `Allow` header, and unknown paths return 404 `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND`.
